texto: To ask the price of an individual item is used «Hoeveel kost dit / deze appel?» (How much does it cost...?). For several articles in plural, the form is used in -in: «Hoeveel kosten drie appels?» (How much do they cost...?). The expression «per stuk» means «por unidad» or «each».

frases.en: Good afternoon, how much is this apple?
And how much are three blocks?

frases.es: Dos euros con cincuenta en total.
frases.en: Two euros and fifty in total.

bloques.pregunta: What is the difference between «kost» and «kosten» when asking prices?

opciones.texto: «Kost» is used for a singular and «kosten» article for several plural
opciones.explicacion: Compulsory consistency with the grammatical subject.

opciones.texto: «Kost» is the formal form with «u» and «kosten» the informal
opciones.explicacion: Both forms depend on the number of the noun, not the courtesy treatment.

opciones.texto: «Kost» is used for food and «kosten» for clothing or objects
opciones.explicacion: The type of goods does not alter the conjugation of the verb.

bloques.pregunta: How much does each apple cost separately?

opciones.explicacion: «Per stuk» specifies the price of each individual unit.

opciones.texto: Two and a half euros per unit.
opciones.explicacion: Two and fifty is the price for the three blocks together.
The text indicates a euro («één euro»).

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the right plural verbal shape for three blocks.

opciones.explicacion: With the plural subject «drie appels» the verb is concluded in plural («kosten»).
It is the form of singular, valid only for one apple («deze appel kost»).
It is a noun («unidad»), not the conjugated verbal form.

bloques.pregunta: What is the joint price offered by the seller?

opciones.texto: Two euros with fifty cents in total.
Three euros in total with discount.
One euro with fifty for all three.
opciones.explicacion: It combines fifty cents with one and a half euros.

bloques.pregunta: Complete to ask how much the apple costs.

opciones.explicacion: «Hoeveel» is the quantitative question to ask «How much?».

bloques.traduccion: Good afternoon, how much is this apple?
bloques.explicacion: Initial greeting, question of quantity and verb conjugated in singular.

intro: He asked about the price of individual items and as a whole and understood the total cost.
